definition: How a candidate reads against the corpus, higher being better: a weighted blend of axes, each the share of its own checks that came back clean, so a bigger house is not marked down for being checked more. An axis nothing could check is dropped.
basis: Our wording of the composer's score. build/compose.py: "It is not a total of what is wrong", each axis is a share of its own denominator, "so a bigger house is not penalised for being checked more times", and an axis nothing could be evaluated on is "never scored as a pass and never as a zero".
